facts.fact: The Leveraged Years says law 09-08 governs how personal data may be processed in any sector and, per the CNDP, already governs AI processing.
The Leveraged Years names the CNDP as Morocco's data protection authority acting under law 09-08.
The Leveraged Years says the CNDP issued a communique stating that law 09-08 already governs AI processing of personal data; no decision on a controller is stated.
facts.system: CNDP communique on AI and personal data
